description: # Power BI Variance Chart with Small Multiples and IBCS®-Inspired Design Build clear and professional variance reports in Power BI with a flexible custom visual for comparing values against reference values such as budget, forecast, target, or previous year. The base chart displays **value, reference value, and deviation** in one compact view. Actual and reference values are shown as **overlapping bars or columns**, making differences easy to identify at a glance. You can extend the base chart with an **Absolute Variance Chart** and a **Percent Variance Chart**, creating a complete three-chart layout: **Base, Absolute Variance, and Percent Variance**. Choose the best orientation for your analysis: use **horizontal charts for time series** and **vertical charts for categories**. Each of the three chart types can also be displayed as a **single chart or as small multiples**, giving you powerful flexibility for comparing multiple categories, regions, products, or business units. The visual includes practical chart settings familiar from other dataviz.boutique visuals and follows an **IBCS®-inspired approach** for clear, consistent, and business-focused reporting. Ideal for financial dashboards, controlling reports, sales analysis, KPI dashboards, and management reporting. **Extra charges apply to remove the watermark.**
